title: Define beat thread hook and threat-clock ownership
objective: Define beat thread hook and threat-clock ownership; expected: structural history is persistent and source-pinned.
status: Source-backed contract installed; build, actual physical PostgreSQL qualification, independent evaluation and integration gates remain unperformed.

current_authority.note: These current source preimage pins supersede archived source-only findings. The unchanged native source/model/schema defines the contract; fixture and test edits require a new source-bound build and executable admission.

decision.selected: Retain structural history in the existing canonical complete GameState checkpoint and its accepted ordered fact/decision references, with immutable source/content/rules/handler/build pins and the existing fenced session/PostgreSQL writer.
decision.reason: This implements the original persistent and source-pinned structural outcome without introducing another model, storage writer, transition schema or public action.

alternatives.choice: A second narrative store or independently committing director
alternatives.reason: It would split canonical state and bypass engine/session fenced durability.

alternatives.choice: A new complete typed transition history or threat causal ledger
alternatives.reason: The original D01 boundary preserves current structural state and accepted causes. Full reconstruction needs complete versioned reducers, source decisions and matching state-hash evidence.

alternatives.choice: Treat codec-only or selected-but-ignored tests as physical durability evidence
alternatives.reason: Actual native story PG recovery and all-record physical postmaster restart/readback must execute against the current admitted source/build.

alternatives.choice: Create live consent or advance threat clocks through the persistence fixture
alternatives.reason: The hook consent generation and static clock are explicit fixture inputs, not authored gameplay or World time decisions.

ownership.df_model: Owns GameState/NarrativeState, CharacterHook, StoryArc and ThreatClock once. Checkpoint validation binds references, order, resources, consent-generation presence, audience members and limits.
ownership.df_content: Owns immutable campaign/source definitions and trusted admission inventory. Persisted bytes cannot admit foreign content or alter source versions.
ownership.df_narrative: Pure beat selection and accepted-fact/thread consequence policy stages detached NarrativeState, causal references and bounded proposals; no database or clock writer.
ownership.df_world: Owns source-grounded logical-time and threat-clock progression. Narrative relevance consumes admitted clock evidence; it cannot advance the clock.
ownership.hooks_and_arcs: Canonical continuity records retain definition/phase, member, accepted source IDs, positive consent generation, audience and active hook references. Live hook authoring and authorized consent admission remain unresolved.
ownership.df_engine: Composes typed staged proposals with rules authority and validates their permitted mutation surface.
ownership.df_session: Owns one serialized durable decision, exact operation lookup/retry, fenced revision, and publication/effect dispatch after durable acknowledgement.
ownership.df_persistence: Owns the native complete checkpoint codec, trusted re-decode, one PostgreSQL transaction and exact source-pinned recovery.
ownership.df_tools_native_owner: Registered generated-service actions use local member authority, actor::Engine, HarborEngine and the existing journey selectors; the operator test exercises the actual BeginStory/EscortCourier path.
ownership.projection_and_media: Only authorized committed facts may support narrative realization/recaps. This change does not implement audience UI, cinematic jobs, summary truth, or a public history API.

GameState.continuity.arcs with phase, source_facts and active_hooks

structural_record_contract.beats_threads: NarrativeState retains active/completed beats, open threads and accepted fact IDs. Native journey validates accepted terminal ContentEvent, decision policy, prerequisites, phase and thread consequences. The owned-PG test checks the actual BeginStory and EscortCourier path.
structural_record_contract.hooks_arcs: ContinuityState retains CharacterHook consent_generation, scoped audience, definition/source facts and StoryArc phase/active hook references. The owned-PG fixture explicitly supplies these already-admitted records; it does not issue consent or create playable hook content.
structural_record_contract.threat_clock: GameState.threats retains ThreatClock ID, content definition, progress and capacity. The owned-PG fixture tests storage of an already-admitted value only. df-world remains the clock progression owner; no native journey clock producer is present.
structural_record_contract.source_pins: CheckpointPins retains exact content/package/rules/handler digests and BuildIdentity; model checks references against trusted inventory; native repository re-decodes every candidate and fenced startup restore refuses mismatched pins. The test fixture uses fixed synthetic pins and is identified as such.

all_record_physical_restart_case.database_precondition: On Root's fresh isolated cluster, create an empty named database, apply the exact current crates/df-persistence/migrations/0001_game_decisions.sql, then exact current fixtures/owned_pg_authority.sql and fixtures/owned_pg_faults.sql under the registered admin role. These are test fixture schemas/roles only; the suite seeds and commits session 49. Validate actual database, role, data directory, port, isolation and durability settings. Existing suite requires the two distinct env ports and rejects 55439.
all_record_physical_restart_case.expected_checks: The source postimage makes fixture_recovery_candidate include completed beat/open thread/accepted fact, scoped hook/arc/static threat clock. Commit suite validates full stored families; readback checks exact receipt, load_current == candidate, explicit assert_fixture_structural_recovery, physical envelope equality and no extra decision. A static fixture does not prove live hook consent or clock advancement.
required_environment: DUNGEONFLUX_I01_OWNED_PROXY_PORT=<distinct Root-reserved actual loopback port other than 55439 for commit suite>
all_record_physical_restart_case.restart_order: Run commit suite once to terminal success and observe the physical session-49 stored checkpoint/receipt. Close and account for all native/admin connection drivers. Stop only the birth/executable-verified owned postmaster within its registered bound; verify clean stop, then restart that exact postmaster binary over the same retained data directory and system identifier on the same registered port. Run the readback selector separately with the same source-bound executable and database/role env. Readback performs no seeding or decision write.

root_runtime_admission.finite_release: Use a fresh task-specific bounded owned-process controller derived from existing Root-admitted I01/recovery tooling, with current measured memory/time/pressure caps; do not import stale limits as a grant. Admit executable/source/SQL/PG binary identities before start and recheck them after terminal, track only birth-matched descendants, stop only owned postmaster, verify all test/PG child processes and backend sessions absent, retain exact terminal stdout/stderr/process/physical receipts. Any timeout, cleanup failure, source mismatch, or ignored/unrun case remains FAIL/PENDING.

unresolved_facts: No runtime source authoring/consent action currently creates CharacterHook or StoryArc in the native journey. The synthetic fixture's consent_generation value is test input only and is never projected as real user consent.

No df-world producer currently advances a ThreatClock in the native journey; a static fixture clock tests persistence only. The journey's Short Rest still refuses nonempty threats, so do not seed the playable flow with a fixture clock.

The source packet does not claim a complete typed per-transition history ledger, event reconstruction, gameplay clock mechanics or authorized audience UI projection. Existing canonical checkpoint state and accepted ordered facts are the bounded original D01 history contract.
The new ignored PG test uses a fresh named owned loopback database and exact environment admission. It must not be counted as passing until Root actually runs and observes it.
